title: French Omelette with Spicy Kick
description: A classic French omelette with a spicy twist, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of butter to the pan and let it melt.
Pour the eggs into the pan and let them cook for about 30 seconds.
Use a spatula to gently lift the edges of the omelette and tilt the pan so the uncooked egg can flow underneath.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the eggs are almost set.
Add the spicy to one half of the omelette and fold the other half over it.
Cook for another 30 seconds and then slide the omelette onto a plate.
